meta.name: stock-monitor
meta.description: 股票价格实时监控。支持多只股票监控，使用 Yahoo Finance API 获取实时股价，自定义涨跌阈值提醒。当股价波动超过设定阈值时自动发送提醒，支持首次预警和续警机制。用于：(1) 监控持仓股票价格波动 (2) 设置价格提醒 (3) 定期检查股价变化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 监控股票价格波动，自动发送阈值提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯盘或设置股价提醒
copy.tagline_en: Monitor stock price movements and send automatic threshold alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track stock prices and get notified on threshold breaches

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以实时监控你指定的多只股票价格，当涨跌超过设定阈值时自动发送提醒，并支持首次预警和续警。
howto.when: 当你配置好股票列表并运行监控脚本后，每5分钟自动检查一次股价，当波动超过阈值时触发提醒。

say.text: 帮我监控茅台、腾讯和拼多多的股价，涨跌超过2%提醒我。
say.note: Claude 会配置股票列表并启动监控。

say.text: 检查一下我的股票有没有触发预警。
say.note: Claude 会运行监控脚本并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can monitor multiple stock prices in real-time, send alerts when price changes exceed set thresholds, and supports first alert and follow-up alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you configure the stock list and run the monitoring script; it checks prices every 5 minutes and alerts when thresholds are exceeded.

say_en.text: Monitor Moutai, Tencent, and PDD stock prices, alert me if they change more than 2%.
say_en.note: Claude will configure the stock list and start monitoring.

say_en.text: Check if any of my stocks have triggered an alert.
say_en.note: Claude will run the monitoring script and report results.
